unit.why: A single narrative: hasidim on their way to the rebbe survive a ferry sinking on the Vistula by miracle, which is then linked to his Sabbath Torah discourse.

stories.end_quote: נצבים היום בר״ה כולם באין מחסור
stories.summary_en: Before Rosh Hashanah an overloaded ferry sank in the Vistula near Sabin and many drowned, leaving agunot. All the hasidim travelling to the rebbe at Magielnica were miraculously saved. People then understood that his Friday-night discourse on 'Atem nitzavim' had been a hidden effort to save them.
